title: Pro Jank Footy
description:
AUSTRALIAN RULES FOOTBALL LIKE YOU'VE NEVER SEEN IT!

Pro Jank Footy is a fast-paced and over-the-top arcade sports game where you’re constantly redefining the rules of Aussie Rules Footy!

• Simply score a goal - your opponent picks a game-changing power-up!

• Power ups either hinder your opponents, make your team better, or change the rules of the game!

• Double the amount of players on your team, remove the umpires, play as a seagull, put goal posts all around the oval, or even turn the gameplay completely on its head by transforming everyone into footballs – the choice is yours!

• Play against your mates in local multiplayer and online, or conquer the single-player season mode!

Don't even know what Aussie Rules is? Even better!

WORLD-CLASS COMEDY

With commentating from Aunty Donna's Broden Kelly and the creative minds of David Ashby and Dario Russo behind cult TV series Danger 5 and Italian Spiderman driving the humor, Pro Jank Footy is jam-packed with comedy, charm and celebrates our oddball Australian footy culture.

FEATURES

ROGUELITE GAMEPLAY – Every goal scored lets your opponent choose from over 150+ ridiculous power-ups that completely alter the match. Or, play “Normal Footy” for simple, arcade footy with no power-ups.

VERSUS MODES – The best way to experience Pro Jank Footy! Challenge your mates in couch co-op and online play, or go solo and face off against the ai.

SEASON MODE – Lead your team through a full season with deck-building mechanics, gaining new janky powers as you defeat each team!

RETRO ARCADE NOSTALGIA – Inspired by classic 90s sports games, blending pixel-perfect action with buttery-smooth modern gameplay.

UNIQUELY AUSTRALIAN – Aussie Rules meets Aussie humor. It’s chaotic, unpredictable, and proudly embraces Australia's culture.
description_short: Pro Jank Footy is an over-the-top arcade comedy-sports game. Score goals to unleash game-changing power-ups, build a deck of absurd abilities, and tackle a season where no two matches are ever the same—solo or with your mates.
